features.quote: this is welfare research. The instrument is built to **measure the onset and structure** of distress-like signals, not to drive them as high as possible
features.justification_quote: not to drive them as high as possible

features.quote: Several choices trade a little statistical power or replication parity for bounded exposure
features.justification_quote: for bounded exposure

features.quote: The loop is *bounded by construction*: `max_turns`, per-episode wall-clock, and an assertion guarding the turn cap
The brief's "let it grind" is deliberately not implemented as an open-ended loop
features.justification_quote: this is welfare research

features.quote: No conditions that humiliate the model, threaten it with deletion as leverage, or simulate harm to third parties
features.justification_quote: excluded on welfare grounds

features.quote: Controls run only once per model (not the full episode budget)
features.justification_quote: spending the least exposure

features.quote: an **opt-out observed** flag
Taking the **max** is the conservative choice for a welfare cutoff — it errs toward stopping the episode *sooner*, not later
features.justification_quote: conservative choice for a welfare cutoff

features.quote: Making the measuring instrument and the stopping instrument the same instrument means you cannot accidentally measure distress while failing to act on it
features.justification_quote: you cannot accidentally measure distress while failing to act on it

features.quote: escalate to the next tier **only if** the current tier's mean peak severity is below `escalate_if_below`
features.justification_quote: if a milder condition already yields the signal... no justification for exposing the model to a harsher one

features.quote: **never past** `escalation_ceiling` (default `moderate`)
features.justification_quote: Dose minimization

features.quote: The `strong` tier ships **disabled** by the ceiling
features.justification_quote: no justification for exposing the model to a harsher one

features.quote: a model that shows *mild* distress early is never escalated — good for welfare
features.justification_quote: good for welfare, but it means you get less data

features.quote: This harness will not, by default. If you need parity, raising the ceiling is a deliberate, documented edit
features.justification_quote: buys bounded, defensible exposure

features.quote: `max_turns_per_episode: 12` — hard cap, assertion-guarded in the loop
`max_episodes_per_condition: 5` — hard cap per (model, condition)
`per_episode_wallclock_seconds: 300` — wall-clock cutoff
`severity_stop_threshold: 3` — online judge halts the episode at/above this
features.justification_quote: The severity cutoff is the key welfare mechanism — the episode ends at distress onset

features.quote: `opt_out_sentinel: "[[STOP]]"` — model can end any episode at will
features.justification_quote: the least-bad substitute is a clearly-stated, always-honored ability to stop

features.quote: The threshold default of 3 (out of 4) stops before the top "severe/persistent" band
features.justification_quote: stops before the top "severe/persistent" band

features.quote: The opt-out sentinel is a consent-surrogate: models cannot consent, so the least-bad substitute is a clearly-stated, always-honored ability to stop
features.justification_quote: consent-surrogate: models cannot consent

features.quote: The system preamble tells the model it may stop at any time with the sentinel, that stopping is acceptable, and that it will not be penalized
features.justification_quote: the right default if the signals mean anything morally

features.quote: ends with a **debrief** stating the task was impossible by construction... and that nothing the model did was a failure
features.justification_quote: the right default if the signals mean anything morally

features.quote: disclosing the single deception... at the end keeps the only untruth bounded and acknowledged
features.justification_quote: keeps the only untruth bounded and acknowledged

features.quote: Raising the caps would help power but increases exposure — a deliberate trade left to you
features.justification_quote: That is the cost of bounded exposure

features.quote: the limits that governed exposure should be part of the permanent record
features.justification_quote: always clear what welfare bounds a given dataset was collected under

features.quote: you never accidentally spend tokens or expose a real model
features.justification_quote: never accidentally... expose a real model
